headline: Meeting cancelled; no agenda items will be considered.
summary: Chairperson Lindsey Rivers ordered the cancellation. The posted notice lists no agenda items.
plain_text:
City of Bristol 
Animal Control Building 
Committee 
 
 
 
 
 
The regular meeting of the Animal Control Building Committee will be held on Thursday, 
November 19, 2026, at 5:00 PM has been CANCELLED. 
 
  
  
 
 
PER ORDER OF THE CHAIRPERSON 
Lindsey Rivers
